questions.prompt: How many layers does the TCP/IP model have? (a number)
TCP/IP's Application layer covers which OSI layers?
What does TCP/IP's Internet layer do?
options: Defines the datagram (the IP packet) and routes it

questions.prompt: The TCP/IP model specifies which cables and hardware a network must use.
A switch makes forwarding decisions using…
options: IP addresses in the packet header
Hardware (MAC) addresses in the frame header

questions.prompt: Which device works at layer 1 and looks at nothing, just repeating the signal?
A router forwards packets using which kind of address? (two letters)
Someone says "layer 3 switch". Which numbering are they using, and what does the device forward by?
options: TCP/IP numbering; forwards by MAC address
OSI numbering; forwards packets by IP address
OSI numbering; forwards by port number
TCP/IP numbering; forwards by port number
